channel.title: Star Catcher: new Claude repos
channel.description: New Claude, Claude Code and MCP repos, found every 6 hours.

item.title: opengame by nexu-io (★954)
item.description: The Super Game Agent — the Unity & Unreal for AI agents, with 100+ viral games to remix. Turn 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, etc.) into a full-stack AI game studio. Build and publish 3D & mini-games to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok, Telegram, itch.io, and more.

item.title: rea-games by erkamyaman (★309)
item.description: Reverse-engineer any game, rebuild it in any engine (web, Rust, Godot) and prove the rebuild plays the same, frame by frame. Behavior specs in the open GAME.md format.

item.title: claude-desktop by bytebuildsmall (★250)
item.description: Claude Desktop for Windows 10/11. Chats with Claude AI to draft documents, analyze files and code, and answer questions from a native desktop app with quick access to your projects and conversations.

item.title: safe-anything by erkamyaman (★788)
item.description: Find the holes before someone else does. A fast, 100% Rust vulnerability scanner: XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, dependency CVEs and AI agent setups.

item.title: agent-sim by Developing-Gamer (★615)
item.description: iOS simulators for AI agents, on Linux. The agent layer for x86Sim.

item.title: claude-desktop-app-win by christinesoft17 (★407)
item.description: Anthropic Claude Desktop App - AI assistant application for conversational interaction, document analysis and task automation on Windows 10/11

item.title: KuroCat by qianyiai (★1.4k)
item.description: KuroCat — Free open-source 3D/2D desktop typing cat & AI coding companion (Bongo Cat alternative · Tauri v2 + Rust + MCP · Claude/Codex/DeepSeek/OBS · Win/Mac/Linux/Android)｜开源3D桌面打字小黑猫与AI伴侣

item.title: fast-anything by EL4CTEO (★4.2k)
item.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.

item.title: skill-distill by sybil-solutions (★920)
item.description: Distill a good Claude Code / Codex session into a skill an open-weight model can follow to reproduce the task

item.title: sprite-stacking by danielwh2 (★1.0k)
item.description: Agent skill: turn four pixel art views into fake-3D sprites you can spin. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi.

item.title: blender-ai-mcp-addon by bookwjitchieni1986 (★2.8k)
item.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

item.title: ApexCluster by Johnson-Durui (★286)
item.description: 面向复杂软件工程与产品设计的旗舰级跨厂商多 Agent 集群：架构层直出 PRD、技术架构与交互原型（完美适配产品经理任务），实现层跨厂互审与沙箱实证交付 | Multi-vendor AI cluster: Architecture layer outputs PRDs & prototypes (built for PMs), Implementation ships Docker-verified code.

item.title: gtavi-claudecode by Bodila51 (★1.0k)
item.description: Claude Code plugin that turns GTA 6 streams into paid vertical clips: live campaigns, trending videos, best moments, 9:16 cuts with hooks, captions and credits.

item.title: open-diagram by lukendeasy (★404)
item.description: Python building blocks for dense architecture diagrams that check their own layout

item.title: claude-shorts-skills by fahniazz (★342)
item.description: Claude Code skills that turn your PC into an animation studio: 3D cartoon story Shorts (three.js + Remotion), word-synced green-screen captions, Minecraft short scripts and multi-agent Minecraft story videos. No AI video generator.

item.title: open-artifact by JimLiu (★628)
item.description: Open, agent- and model-agnostic artifacts, all saved locally as plain files — edit, comment on, and export slides, UI designs, design systems, whiteboards, sheets, dashboards, docs, and motion.

item.title: mobile-agent-testers by pierridotite (★2.5k)
item.description: 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners: Claude Code agents on iOS Simulators and Android emulators that find broken flows, translation, layout and accessibility bugs

item.title: nihongo by AnIT012 (★228)
item.description: AIが書く日本語を、人が書く文に近づけるエージェントスキル。Claude、ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codexなどで使えます。

item.title: boring-marketing-skills by boringmarketer (★529)
item.description: 32 free marketing skills for your AI agent: research, positioning, copy, pages, SEO, AI search, ads, email and content, plus a deep local-business pack. MIT.

item.title: motlab by staryone (★422)
item.description: Video as code: canvas scenes rendered with WebCodecs in headless Chrome, a review viewer, and agent skills that build the video from your references.

item.title: rust-anything by erkamyaman (★10k)
item.description: Rewrite your app in Rust, piece by piece, checked against the original at every step. Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Ruby, Java, C, PHP, C#, Kotlin and PowerShell.

item.title: lemo-animi by lemomo-ai (★266)
item.description: Stop-motion shorts from one line, made with Codex: eight material styles, puppets drawn by an image model and moved frame by frame in code. 一句话，用 Codex 做一支定格动画短片。

item.title: claude-multi-desktop by jackson-cmd (★485)
item.description: Run multiple Claude Desktop accounts at the same time on Mac: separate sign-ins, custom icons, one shared Claude Code setup, and sessions that message each other across accounts. brew install jackson-cmd/tap/claude-multi-desktop

item.title: craft by diego3g (★506)
item.description: Design skills for AI agents: /craft-setup writes your design brief, /craft designs screens with every state from your design system and reviews them. Works with Paper, pen.dev, Figma or HTML.

item.title: serum-2-desktop by azure-fossil-maker (★210)
item.description: Serum 2 2026 standalone bundle with full plugin suite, multitrack editor, bundled instruments and portable offline mode for Windows 11

item.title: Capri-AI by Outpostkrewhirl86 (★345)
item.description: Capri: a local-first desktop AI agent with a cyberpunk HUD. Your personal Jarvis for Windows. Controls files, apps, terminal and browser, powered by Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or any backend. Inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
